items.title: Reformation’s 3Q Net Revenue Grows 19%
items.summary: By Karen Roman Reformation Inc. (NYSE: REF) said third quarter net revenue increased 19.1% to $173.6 million compared to the year prior thanks to strength across channels and geographies, with DTC net revenues rising 16.7% to $152.8 million.
